title: The Mary Poppins girl would thrive in Lost Boys tbh
transcript: Round 26 and hello new camera angle, y'all. Can we please talk about the music direction in Lost Boys for a second? Now, the show is music directed by Julie McBride with music supervision by Ethan Popp. And they really brought this rock score by the Rescues to life beautifully. The way that every single performer gets to make choices that fit their voices. But not only that, I feel like even seeing these performers more than once, they make choices depending on the day and how their voices feel in the moment. I swear, every time I see Shoshana Bean do Lucy, she's bringing out new riffs I've never heard on a stage before. And there are certain shows where the music direction will be very strict because maybe that's what the show calls for. For example, in a show like wicked, there are set riffs that you can do for Defying Gravity. Now, I imagine in a show like Lost Boys, there are specific songs that you can't really do anything different with, like take my heart with you, right? They have to be so precise. Those harmonies have to be perfect every time, and they are every single night. But for a song like Wild, or even the the end of the Good Part, where Lucy as a character is really letting herself go, it makes sense for that character to really be able to do whatever her voice is feeling that night. And we get that Not just when Shoshana is on, but also with Ashley and Delaney. They each have their own unique riffs that fits so well with their voices, not even just with a character like Lucy David, for example. Pierre was on again tonight as David and makes very different vocal choices and riff choices from Ali. They're both fantastic, but it's fun to see different performers be able to get to play with the notes in the song. And I think because of that, it really helps to keep the rock feel of this score, because traditional musical theatre is very. You need to sing the notes on the page, not in Lost Boys. Shout out to Dominic Dorset, who made his Dwayne debut today and absolutely killed it. I said it before and I'll say it again, I love getting to see what all of the covers choices are for specific ones. And there was one that he made today with the stereo that I love. I just love it so much. I do.
